# matches any entry (a regular expression). Used by .github/workflows/linting.yaml and
# .github/workflows/url-health.yaml.

README.md

_config.yml

# Tests use sample URLs, including deliberately broken ones
tests/test_

# CI config and issue templates contain example URLs. Don't shorten these to
# ".github/": entries are regular expressions matched against absolute paths,
# and in GitHub Actions every file is under /github/workspace/.
.github/workflows
.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE

# Archived newsletters were sent by email and are kept as a record
